description: Preview tracking an immutable Explore selection's searches, each under its Explore Topic, on the chosen platforms and cadence, without tracking anything. Returns the server plan, its planFingerprint, each Topic's searches (topics), searches already tracked on another cadence (cadenceChanges) and whether confirmation is required. Selected searches are tracked under their Explore Topic. For ungrouped searches, supply topicName or use the grouping returned by setup_explore_selection_sources_v1 in the activation preview (topics and ungroupedTopicName). Existing Topics with the same name are reused.

body.description: Optional complete canonical activationPreview body; explicit fields override it.

cadence.description: Refresh cadence; defaults to weekly. Each refresh is charged when it collects.

sourcePlatforms.description: Platforms to track the selected searches on, for example ["tiktok"].

topicName.description: Selected searches are tracked under their Explore Topic. For ungrouped searches, supply topicName or use the grouping returned by setup_explore_selection_sources_v1 in the activation preview (topics and ungroupedTopicName). Existing Topics with the same name are reused.

name: socialseal_explore_preview_activation
title: Preview Explore activation
